choices.name: Striking Light
effects: Basic abilities trigger Light of Saradomin on a 9-second cooldown for 40-60% ability damage plus 250% of armour value.

assumptions: Striking Light's +40% damage modifier applies to the four Basic Attacks. Light of Saradomin can trigger from any Basic-category ability.
Light triggers from the first landed direct hit while off cooldown, is a separate critical-eligible hit with its own cap, and takes 250% of the same total Armour stat Teragard's Aegis reads.
A multi-hit Basic ability triggers Light once: the 9-second cooldown outlives the cast.

choices.name: Barkscales
effects: Incoming damage is reduced by 10% of armour value.
After five reductions, triggers Grasp of Guthix for 80-120% ability damage as poison in a 3x3 area.

assumptions: The trigger rate needs an incoming qualifying-hit interval, which an outgoing rotation cannot supply; without one the blessing reports no calculated damage rather than zero.
The reduction takes 10% of the total Armour stat, and the five-hit counter is read as resetting to zero on each trigger.
Grasp is poison damage, so it is not critical-eligible and deals nothing to a poison-immune target; when Cinders is active, each Grasp hit still receives Cinders effects.
Each occupied tile of the 3x3 is counted as one Grasp application.

choices.name: Abyssal Cinders
effects: On hit: Your attacks deal 15% of ability damage as bonus damage.
On hit: Your attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an Inferno of Zamorak, which deals 100-200% ability damage to a single target.

excluded: Familiars and dreadnips, which the simulator does not represent
assumptions: Every independent player-sourced or conjure damage hit receives one attached, non-critical 15% base-ability-damage rider and one 5% Inferno roll; this includes damage-over-time, poison, Crackling, Aftershock, equipment procs, reflected hits and separate blessing hits.

Inferno is a separate critical-eligible hit that repeats both Cinders effects and can trigger another Inferno. The simulator evaluates the geometric chain as p / (1 - p) expected Inferno activations instead of scheduling unbounded recursive events.

Attached bonus-damage components are not hits and cannot trigger Cinders. All ability-damage-scaled components use the simulation's already-resolved base ability damage, which includes Eruptive and other loadout base-AD modifications.

reason: Model Abyssal Cinders on every independent player and conjure damage hit, including recursive Inferno hits, with a bounded geometric expected-value calculation.
